# Adam R. Cagle

> Adam R. Cagle is a creative director, lead copywriter, and builder of production AI systems. He is co-founder, Creative Director, and Lead Copywriter at Agency689, a full-service identity, branding, and launch studio in Bend, Oregon. His sister studio Agentic689 ships production AI agents and AI-assisted creative workflows on the Anthropic Claude API. Twenty-five years of work across gaming, hospitality, music, and consumer tech. Ad Club and Webby honored for copy.

## Who

- Name: Adam R. Cagle
- Roles: Creative Director, Copywriter, AI Systems Architect
- Studios: Agency689 (branding and launch studio, founded 2001) and Agentic689 (AI agents, founded 2024)
- Based: Bend, Oregon
- Contact: adamrcagle@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/adamcagle/

- [Creative Writing](https://adamcagle.com/creative-writing.html): long-form fiction and nonfiction samples. Ship Happens, The Deal, The Ledger, The Vampire's Babysitter.
